title: Sandboxed Tool Authorization
summary: Filters an agent's tools through deny-first allow and deny patterns, profile presets, and subagent policies that inherit parent restrictions
signals: Agents with different roles need different tool access
Subagents must get stricter permissions than their parent
Plugin tools must join policies without manual allowlist updates
Development and production need different permissions
anti_signals: Single agent with a small, fixed tool set
Team cannot audit many per-agent policies
